tactics.general: Two ogres with him. Control one, tank Omokk away from the group with your back to a wall (knockback). Either kill Omokk first with both adds controlled, or kill one add then him. He enrages and hits hard.
Two Blackhand Priests with her. Control one, pull her away from the group because her Hex can hit several players. Kill the priests first, then her. Remove Curse of Blood.
No guards but hits very hard. Wait for threat. Tank him against a wall.

abilities.name: Mother's Milk
abilities.note: Needed for a quest. Nearby spiders drop a cure.

tactics.general: Crystallize is a cone stun, face her away. Mother's Milk stuns her target and people next to them.

abilities.name: Strike
abilities.timing: when its target is in melee range, every 5-9s

tactics.general: Waves of elite ogres come first. Every 30 seconds you can click the pike on the tribute pile while targeting an ogre to kill it outright. Use that plus control. After about ten ogres Urok arrives: warrior-like, with a fear. Let the tank get threat.

abilities.name: Shoot
abilities.timing: when its target is 5-35 yards away, every 2-3s

tactics.general: Throws a stun bomb that hits players around, spread a bit. Hooked Net roots a player, freedom effects and Escape Artist help.
Arrives soon after Halycon. Hits hard, Fatal Bite heals him, Infected Bite is a nature damage over time. Let the tank build threat.
Comes with worg pups, kill them, then her. Low damage. Right after she dies, recover fast: Gizrul runs in soon.
Face him away with your back to a wall. At 50% he calls adds: control them and burn him, then the adds.
tactics.tank: Face him away, back to a wall. Grab any uncontrolled adds at 50%.
tactics.healer: Move near the tank when the adds appear, your healing pulls them.

abilities.name: Fire Nova
abilities.note: Fire nova, casters and healers stay 10+ yards away.

tactics.general: Click the Blackrock Altar to start. AoE down the low-health Incarcerators. Tank Emberseer away from the group for his fire nova.

abilities.name: War Stomp
abilities.note: War Stomp, ranged and healers stay back.

tactics.general: Hug the north wall to reach Father Flame at the far end, clear the dragonspawn, click Father Flame. Waves come: kill Rookery Hatchers first (they break eggs), mages and warlocks handle whelps, tanks hold Rookery Guardians on the east wall. Then Solakar: tank him on the wall, ranged stay back from his War Stomp.
Drops off Gyth at 20%. Kill after Gyth. Melee move out of his Whirlwind, avoid the cleave.

abilities.name: Fireball
abilities.timing: when its target is 5-40 yards away, every 8-10s

tactics.general: Charges a random player, then returns to the top threat target, so the tank must stay on top. Fears players near him. Flamebreak does fire damage and knocks back.

abilities.name: Conflagration
abilities.note: Burst plus 10 seconds of control, then damages nearby players. Off-tank takes over if it hits the main tank.

tricks.title: Hunter kite
tricks.text: A hunter pulls Drakkisath back into the Beast's room and feigns death, buying time for the tanks to kill his guards first.

tactics.general: Hardest boss here because of his Chromatic Elite Guards. Either tank everything in place and cleave the guards down (warlock fear on one helps), or have a hunter kite him back toward the Beast's room and feign death while tanks kill the guards. Face him away for Flame Breath.

Rend gauntlet: survive seven or eight waves of orcs and dragonspawn, then Rend arrives on Gyth. Main tank faces Gyth away for his breath. At 20% Rend falls off: off-tank takes Rend to the side. Kill Gyth, then Rend.
tactics.tank: Face Gyth away. Off-tank grabs Rend when he drops.
